description: Use to follow one model on one job over time (for example, has it got cheaper or worse). Returns its published days: right answers, items, cost per 1,000 right in US dollars and IPD (right answers per dollar). On a job with two tests (Extract, Classify), every row names its test; the answer says what the two tests are and when each ran, and rows from the two tests are not comparable. Fields: cost_per_1000_right_usd and ipd are exact; cost_shown and ipd_shown are how the page shows them. assembled_by_us is 1 when the answer was assembled by us, else 0. A count marked "not published for this model" is not published for that model.

model.description: Model or system name for that job, e.g. GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, NL;NL Desk (a system. Not open yet.).

name: get_model_history
title: One model over time
